UPDATE coupons
               SET event_id = ?,
                   code = ?,
                   description = ?,
                   expires_at = ?,
                   max_uses = ?,
                   max_uses_per_user = ?,
                   max_uses_per_event = ?,
                   kind = ?,
                   percent_off = ?,
                   dollars_off = ?,
                   updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
               WHERE id = ?
